# Provenance of the vendored FlatBuffers headers

Vendored **unmodified** (byte-for-byte) for rPST's FlatGeobuf input; see
[FlatGeobuf input](../../../docs/spatial-io/flatgeobuf-input.md) for the current interface and format requirements.
Only the header-only C++ library files that the FlatGeobuf-generated headers transitively include are carried
(16 headers); no sources, no `flatc`, no tests. FlatBuffers 24.12.23 remains the parser source authority.

**Location of `base.h`.** 15 headers are in this directory. The 16th, `include/flatbuffers/base.h`, is retained
byte-for-byte (SHA-256 `3f28edd053106cfe229f3887b6f36153785afb347867c55b403da5eff3a88ef8`) at
`inst/upstream/flatbuffers/include/flatbuffers/base.h`, outside the locations (`src/`, `inst/include/`) that
`R CMD check` scans for diagnostic-suppression pragmas. It is the canonical build input; the compiler sees a
generated, build-only copy (below). Nothing vendored is modified.

**Generated build copy.** `R CMD check --as-cran` rejects two upstream GCC diagnostic-suppression blocks in
`base.h` (`#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wstringop-overflow"`, GCC 10 only, and
`"-Wfloat-equal"`, non-MSVC), each written as a `push`/`ignored` conditional block and a matching `pop`
conditional block. `src/portability/strip-flatbuffers-diagnostics.R` deletes exactly those four complete
conditional blocks (14 lines) and nothing else, producing
`src/.rpst-build/flatbuffers/include/flatbuffers/base.h` (SHA-256
`1ef073aaafca01ccd944911ff4678a413884fa8dfb1eb42fecd9b405ad63f693`). No executable FlatBuffers logic changes;
the MSVC `#pragma warning` handling is kept. The copy is regenerated by the build, removed by `rpst-clean`, and
verified fail-closed; it is not an independent fork.

- Upstream repository: `google/flatbuffers`
- Release tag: `v24.12.23`
- Commit: `a2cd1ea3b6d3fee220106b5fed3f7ce8da9eb757`
- Path: `include/flatbuffers/` (the 15 files listed in `SHA256SUMS`; the 16th, `base.h`, is under `inst/upstream/flatbuffers/`); `LICENSE` is the repository's top-level licence file
- Licence: Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`)
- Why this version: the FlatGeobuf generated headers `static_assert` FlatBuffers 24.12.23 exactly; the two must be
  pinned together.

## Licence obligations (established for this set)

* Apache-2.0 section 4(a): recipients receive a copy of the licence (`LICENSE`, shipped with the headers).
* 4(b): modified files must carry change notices. **No file is modified.**
* 4(c): notices in the files are retained as shipped. 15 of the 16 headers carry an Apache licence header; `base.h`
  carries none and is covered by `LICENSE`.
* 4(d): the upstream repository has **no `NOTICE` file** at this tag (`git ls-files`), so there is no NOTICE text to reproduce.
* rPST's own licence is not decided or constrained here beyond preserving these notices. The package-level
  third-party notice is in `inst/COPYRIGHTS`.

## Verification

(The `base.h` build copy is verified as described above: exact upstream hash, each of the four blocks seen exactly
once, exact approved output, no GCC/clang `diagnostic ignored` left, include order and generation dependency in
`Makevars`/`Makevars.win`.)

`Rscript tools/verify-flatgeobuf-vendor.R` (part of `tools/ci/check-local.R`) checks, offline and fail-closed, that the
file set and every SHA-256 equal the pinned table, that `SHA256SUMS` agrees with it, that the licence text is the real
one, that `base.h` is version 24.12.23, and that this record names the pinned tag and commit.
`tools/test-flatgeobuf-vendor.R` proves each kind of drift is rejected.
